notes: This graph reviews art and proposed capability dependencies. Research costs, recipes and unlock enforcement are not implemented. The current outpost deliberately samples later field capabilities early.

nodes.title: Mechanical automation
nodes.description: Extraction, material transport and assembly. The current slice includes extractors, ore belts and a two-ore assembly recipe; a broader mechanical industry remains future work.

nodes.title: Thermal processing
nodes.description: Furnaces, ceramic kilns and material processing form an industrial production branch. No smelting equipment or recipes exist in the current slice.

nodes.title: Electrical distribution
nodes.description: Power generation and wired loads. The current generator supplies 240 units over explicit wires; poles, fuel and network resistance are future extensions.

nodes.title: Instrumented automation
nodes.description: Sensors, control boards and industrial communication. Basic inspectors and diagnostics already exist and remain available; manufacturing these instruments is proposed.

nodes.title: Perimeter defense
nodes.description: Powered sentries protect exposed equipment. Current sentries engage aggressive wildlife within eight tiles; ammunition production is abstracted.

nodes.title: High-frequency interconnects
nodes.description: Faster signals make layout, discontinuities, attenuation and delay visible. This industry branch is proposed; existing field routes already use an effective scattering model.

nodes.title: Dense interconnects
nodes.description: Patterned channels, transparent media and denser transport introduce alignment, mode and spectral problems. This does not claim current modal or dispersion simulation.

nodes.title: Precision materials
nodes.description: Purity, crystal growth and controlled materials enable precision equipment. The current frontier supplies crystal stock, but processing and growth facilities are not implemented.

nodes.title: Thermal management
nodes.description: Heat rejection and safe termination. Cooled dumps, heating, trips and equipment damage exist; coolant plumbing and cooling plants remain proposed.

nodes.title: Precision references
nodes.description: Narrow stable sources expose phase sensitivity and weak reflections. The first outpost already supplies a coherent reference as a deliberate preview of this later capability.

nodes.title: Controlled field networks
nodes.description: Junctions, phase tuners and matched terminations redistribute field energy. Physical ports and grid routes exist independently of their artwork.

nodes.title: Field metrology
nodes.description: Directional power, phase, delay, spectra and mode readouts. Current ports expose incoming/outgoing powers and the energy ledger; richer instrumentation remains proposed.

nodes.title: Automatic calibration
nodes.description: Adaptive tuning and qualification. Automatic phase control and a disturbance acceptance test are playable; distributed calibration infrastructure is future work.

nodes.title: Semiconductor fabrication
nodes.description: Clean processing, deposition, etching and wafer handling create devices. No semiconductor manufacturing simulation is currently installed.

nodes.title: Precision patterning
nodes.description: Stable illumination, alignment and process control enable fine patterning. Asset concepts do not prescribe wavelength, numerical aperture or process recipes.

nodes.title: Decorrelated sources
nodes.description: Deliberately reduce coherence where simple additive power is more robust. The network can distinguish independent source groups; this production technology is not yet a player unlock.

nodes.title: Planetary aperture
nodes.description: Modules, sectors, reference distribution and tracking combine into a planetary transmitter. Full-array scaling and tracking remain future work.

nodes.title: Lightsail fabrication
nodes.description: Precision membrane fabrication and deployment support the long-term lightsail objective. No sail manufacturing or launch gameplay exists yet.
